'''Nomas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who ran a salvage yard during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Nomas was overly talkative on occasion, and was not fond of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] due to their taxes on [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts. However, Nomas had not been affected too badly to sympathize with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Behind the scenes==
Illustrator [[Mike Jackson]] based the image of Nomas on uncredited model [[Tony Heath]].<ref name="JM">{{DeviantArt|username=steampoweredmikej|url=steampoweredmikej/art/Star-Wars-Junkyard-Man-343568755|name=[[Mike Jackson]]|text=Star Wars &ndash; Junkyard Man}}</ref>
